commits.subject: Add slash command argument completion to the TUI composer (#62343)
commits.reason: Complete fixed first arguments of visible slash commands in the terminal. Preserve literal submission, restricted-thread routing and the current draft.
evidence: The composer filters the first token, gives mentions and the configured submit binding precedence, and rechecks the draft, parent-owned restrictions and thread availability before accepting Tab. Disconnected and handoff-restricted input suppress suggestions.

The complete Rust patch from upstream 58ad62ce09 through 42cf4edfcd has the same stable patch ID ada980b2e526002783f27f7623415dc1015348ec on candidate 6dd029d1a4. The fork's form editor still checks for a non-form popup.

The new upstream controls cover draft range replacement, dismissal, shortcut submission, a changed connection or thread and parent-owned commands. The visible picker also has a terminal rendering snapshot.
commits.revisit: Exercise the native controls and a live transfer with a draft containing a partially typed argument, including Tab, Escape and an explicit submit shortcut.
